title: Where Did the Pink Sock Go?
lines: Meg dips a pink sock in the sink.
Mom thinks, then gets a thin net.
Tug, tug! Up it pops with junk on it.
The pink sock is back, and it is wet.
"Thank you, Mom," said Meg with a hug.
"Hang it up," said Mom. "Not in the sink!"

questions.ask: What happens to the sock in the sink?
questions.listenFor: It sinks. If they say "it got wet," ask "and then what did it do?" to get them back to the word sank.

questions.ask: What does Mom use to get the sock back?
questions.listenFor: A thin net. This is stated in the story, so have them reread that line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: What do you think Meg should do next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible plan is fine. You are listening for a because, such as "hang it up, because it sank last time."
